name: NIST iERF
description: NIST Integrated Emergency Response Framework providing standards and guidance for emergency response coordination across multiple agencies and jurisdictions. Supports multi-agency interoperability, communication standards, and coordinated response operations for complex and catastrophic emergencies. Free government publication.
reputation: authoritative NIST standard supporting US emergency response interoperability
notes: Free government publication via govinfo.gov. Addresses technical and organizational interoperability challenges in multi-agency emergency response. Complements NIMS and ICS frameworks.

institutions: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
